about.title: About CalcMintly | CalcMintly
about.description: How CalcMintly builds free, transparent, and easy-to-use online calculators.
about.html:
Useful answers, with the workings shown.

CalcMintly provides 500 free calculators for everyday questions, technical checks and planning scenarios. No account is required.

One question at a time

Each tool has editable assumptions, a reproducible method, an example and limitations. The workspace brings up to four tools together; unit-compatible links are explicit and removable.

Selection and originality

The default directory order is an editorial selection, not a measured global usage ranking. The three original scenario designs combine transparent time, dependency and commitment models; no claim of worldwide uniqueness is made.

How the site is funded

The current calculators are free, with no checkout or account system. Advertising and behavioral analytics are not enabled. If commercial services are added, their terms and data practices will be disclosed before use.

methodology.title: Calculation Methodology and Quality Standards | CalcMintly
methodology.description: CalcMintly formula sources, edge-case testing, result interpretation, and update standards.
methodology.html:
Methods you can inspect and reproduce.

Formula review date: 2026-10-30. Each model states its assumptions. A calculation is evidence about that model, not a guarantee about the real world.

Formula and example standards

New pure models keep inputs, units, calculation logic and reference vectors together. Formula versions identify their source content. Financial examples use entered rates, costs and time conventions; prices and exchange rates are not live feeds.

Scenario interpretation

Case comparisons change stated assumptions. They are not probabilities, causal forecasts, personalized recommendations or eligibility decisions. Custom checklist scores are planning heuristics, with explicit weights and limits.

Primary references

  • Investor.gov — compound interest
  • CFPB — interest conventions
  • NIST — statistical distributions
  • NIST — SI conversion factors
  • BIPM — SI units
  • RFC 4632 — IPv4 CIDR
  • RFC 4291 — IPv6 addressing

A reference supports the relevant definition or method; it does not endorse this website. Tool-specific assumptions and health limitations must be read on the individual page.

Verification and corrections

Releases use numerical references, boundary checks, static-page validation and visual review of affected interfaces. Tested cases and unavailable external measurements are reported separately. Reproduce errors with invented, non-sensitive values through the contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | CalcMintly
privacy.description: How CalcMintly handles calculator inputs, hosting logs, email, analytics, and advertising.
privacy.html:
Keep control of your calculation data.

Effective 2026-10-30. Calculators run locally without a user account or a CalcMintly application database.

Site operator

CalcMintly is operated by an individual. For calculator corrections or privacy requests, contact hello@calcmintly.com. Please do not include sensitive personal information in email.

Inputs and local text parsing

Inputs, scenario snapshots and workspace links normally stay in page memory. The merchant profit planner also has an explicit Save action that stores its plan, including entered assumptions, in this browser until you clear it. The natural-language fill feature uses local text rules; your text is not sent to an AI service. Reloading normally clears inputs. A shared calculation link can restore values you deliberately included.

Preferences and optional device counts

Language and saved layouts use localStorage on this browser. Layouts store calculator choices and order, not inputs. Optional device-only usage counts are off by default, save calculator visit counts only and are cleared when disabled. These counts are not sent to CalcMintly.

Sharing, exports and printing

Layout links contain tool choices only. Calculation-share buttons include selected inputs in the URL fragment; anyone receiving that link can read them. CSV files and print reports contain the values you export. Review them before sharing. Health calculator input sharing is disabled.

Hosting and outside websites

The hosting provider may process IP addresses, request times, browser details and requested paths for delivery and security. URL fragments are not part of ordinary HTTP requests. Third-party reference links follow their own privacy policies.

Analytics, advertising and contact

Behavioral analytics, advertising and nonessential tracking cookies are not enabled. No consent banner is shown for tracking that does not exist. Email sent by you is processed by the mail providers; avoid private financial or health details. Use the contact address for privacy or data-rights requests.

terms.title: Terms of Use | CalcMintly
terms.description: Responsible use of CalcMintly calculators and workspace.
terms.html:
TERMS

Use estimates with understanding.

Effective 2026-10-30. These terms describe use of the free CalcMintly calculators and workspace.

Purpose and responsibility

Tools provide educational calculations and scenario estimates. Check your inputs, units, assumptions and result before relying on it. Results do not establish eligibility, diagnosis or a professional recommendation.

Availability and corrections

Tools may change as errors are corrected or methods improve. Continuous availability and error-free results are not guaranteed. Report reproducible problems through our Contact page.

Fair use

Do not disrupt the website, evade security controls or misrepresent its results. Ordinary calculations run on your device and require no account or payment.

Your rights

Nothing here limits rights or protections that applicable law does not allow us to exclude. Privacy practices are described separately in our Privacy Policy.

contact.title: Contact CalcMintly | CalcMintly
contact.description: Report calculation errors, request new tools, or contact CalcMintly about partnerships and privacy.
contact.html:
CONTACT

Help us make every tool more accurate.

Found a calculation error, a missing edge case, or a calculator we should build? Send us the details.

Site operator

CalcMintly is operated by an individual. For calculator corrections or privacy requests, contact hello@calcmintly.com. Please do not include sensitive personal information in email.

Email

hello@calcmintly.com

Include the calculator name, non-sensitive example inputs, your expected result and a reliable reference. Use made-up values that reproduce the problem; omit account numbers and private financial or health details. Reproducible calculation issues receive priority.

Partnerships and advertising

Commercial relationships must be relevant to the page and clearly disclosed. Sponsorship never changes a formula, diagnostic threshold, or editorial conclusion.

Privacy requests

Current calculators do not upload the values you enter. Email the address above for privacy questions or data-rights requests.

updates.title: Calculator Updates and Formula Revisions | CalcMintly
updates.description: Read CalcMintly release notes, calculator additions, formula corrections, workspace improvements and the limits of each release’s published verification.
updates.html:
What changed in CalcMintly

Release: unified calculator library · 2026-10-30

500 distinct calculators

This release includes a pocket keypad, a scientific keypad, practical calculators across nine categories and three original planning scenarios. Language pages and embedded views are not counted as separate tools.

A clearer workspace

Search every tool directly, start with a goal pack, compare up to four cards and create unit-compatible live links. Local text rules can preview inputs for six core tools before filling them. Layout saving stores tool choices and order only.

Calculation corrections

Rent-versus-buy now compares equal starting resources and invests monthly cash-flow differences. Calendar tools use date-only arithmetic for month ends and leap years. Probability tools preserve small tails and check convergence. Sources, examples and limitations remain visible beside the calculators.

Reading verification claims

Automated numerical checks cover recorded examples and selected boundaries. They do not prove every possible input, clinical validity, worldwide popularity, search indexing, real-user performance percentiles or every browser version.
